I will keep all 13.1 mu in cotton this year. I have done cotton for many years, so I do not change too much unless I see a clear benefit. Around Quzhou, with well water, cotton can still give a steady harvest if I feed it enough and do not let insects get ahead of me. Last year’s way is still my base: I will use a better seed, put the main fertilizer down before or at planting, then topdress later when the plants start growing hard and setting bolls. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than watch the field stay weak. On 13.1 mu, fertilizer, water, and sprays all cost money, so I will not go wild, but I will not cut too close either. I will plough before planting, because cotton likes the soil loosened deeper than a light scratch. Since I have well irrigation, I will plan on about 4 waterings if the weather is normal. For insects and disease, I will watch the field and spray around 5 times in a normal year, more only if pressure gets bad. If weather is decent, I will aim for about 320 kg per mu of seed cotton. Neighbors who manage tightly and water on time can do that, so I will work toward that level too.
